ns2:course.label: Language in Culture II
ns2:course.description: Part II of the core theoretical seminar in linguistic anthropology. Continues examination of historical developments in the sub-field and its debates, and relationships with socio-cultural anthropology. Develops theoretical and critical analytical skills needed in contemporary ethnographic research. Same as LING 518. Prerequisite: Graduate Standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as LING 518. Prerequisite: Graduate Standing.
